ae2c0102-7587-4d89-9c8d-b502322b1b9d.title: Port filesystem_list tool into new Echo with end-to-end chat tool calling
ae2c0102-7587-4d89-9c8d-b502322b1b9d.details:
Port the `filesystem_list` tool from OLD/ into the new Echo, matching OLD exactly (name, params, description, output shape), and wire tool calling into the WebSocket chat handler so the LLM can invoke it end-to-end.

Scope:
- Create internal/tools package (registry, types, arguments, filesystem_helpers, filesystem_list) with init() self-registration identical to OLD.
- Derive labeled workspace roots from the active workspace's folders (label = folder path basename, deduped; '.' for single-root).
- Add a tool-calling loop to internal/server/ws.go handleChatMessage: include tools.LLMSchema() in the ChatRequest, collect streamed tool_call deltas, execute via tools.Execute, feed RoleTool results back, and loop until the model stops calling tools.
- Surface tool activity to the frontend via new WS chat_event eventTypes (e.g. tool_call/tool_result) and render them in web/js/chat.js.
- Add Go tests for the tools package (port OLD filesystem_list tests) and a server/chat integration test using the fake streamer.

Explicitly NOT ported: all other OLD tools (filesystem_read_text, shell_command, etc.). Only filesystem_list.
